PhyloGNN Documentation

PhyloGNN turns phylogenetic trees into PyTorch Geometric graph data and supports GNN training workflows on those graphs.

Use this documentation when you need a practical path from tree input to feature engineering, graph conversion, training, metrics, and API lookup.

Fastest path

Install Start with the core package and add optional extras only for docs, BEAST file input, or experiment tracking. Installation

Quickstart Build a small ETE tree, attach features, convert it to graph data, and inspect the main tensors. Quickstart

Concepts Learn the graph fields and TOML training configuration boundaries before changing workflows. Concepts

Reference Look up curated public APIs for data conversion, models, training, I/O, and utilities. Reference

The usual workflow is tree input, feature engineering, graph conversion, training, optional metrics tracking, and reference lookup when a public API detail matters.
